info.headline: Notify NYC - MTA Disruption - A & C Trains (BK/MN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-02-2026 at 04:18 PM.
Due to a signal problem, expect delays & service changes in both directions on A and C train service between Manhattan and Brooklyn. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit www.mta.info.
